liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the show's most exciting stretch, with Jerry really extending his playing; Reviewer says it rocks and notes Jerry liked playing it in Atlanta [10][18]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Reviewer finds it especially sloppy [16]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer hears a great version with a hot jam, played in an unusual spot in the set [15]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Weir plays acoustic, with a solid performance and no major mistakes; it also aired on The Grateful Dead Hour [10]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Smooth, soulful pairing with That Would Be Something, later aired on an episode of The Grateful Dead Hour [8]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer found this Space extremely trippy, almost like a flashback, and unusually special [17]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 other source): Every soundboard in circulation lacks the encore Brokedown Palace [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-04-01.142364.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-04-01.sbd.leonard.1210.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 159 min [3]
- **gd94-04-01.sbd.miller.14834.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 166 min; rated 3.57/5 by 14 [2]
- **gd1994-04-01.119748.NAK300.Cage.sbeok.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Tickets were very scarce because of Ticketmaster trouble; the reviewer held the only floor seat among their group [9]
- Before the first set Jerry walked out in purple shorts and fiddled with his guitar [13]
- The first set had PA trouble, with low volume and a poor mix, which were gradually fixed [13]
- Reviewer attended at age 14 with a friend and his mother, and remembers it as a sober evening [14]
- Reviewer attended all three Atlanta nights, getting fifth-row mail-order seats for the 3/30 show [18]
- Reviewer says the band rebounded well from a poor show the previous Thursday night [8]
- Reviewer rates this show below the 3/30/94 show, though it has listenable highlights [10]
- Reviewer expected little, since most 1994 shows disappoint them, but found this one better than expected [16]
- Reviewer thinks the three Omni shows that week were quite good, especially for this tour [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-04-01.142364.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: SBD > dat (44.1k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage:… [1]. Also: An unknown audience version that came with it was replaced by a pitch-adjusted shnid 119748, which sounds better [1]
- **gd1994-04-01.sbd.leonard.1210.shnf**: transferred by Brian Leonard; source: DSBD>DAT>CD>CD>SHN (Boot CD Rip) [3]. Also: Encore Brokedown Palace is entirely an audience mix; the original soundboard track was clipped or missing; Uploader cleaned up a few digital pops and split China Cat Sunflower and I Know You Rider into two tracks [3]
- **gd94-04-01.sbd.miller.14834.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info:SBD -> DatTransfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) ->Prodif Plus ->Samplitude v6.0 ->SHNTransfered By Charlie Miller encore from FOB source. [2]
- **gd1994-04-01.119748.NAK300.Cage.sbeok.flac1644**: taped by c. cage; transferred by c. cage; source: nak300>cp4>2ch mixer>sony d7 16/44.1; OTS 2nd row dfc 12ft. DIN dat(m)> hhb830 cd>cdwave>tlh flac 8; t&s by c. cage [4]
